provenance.paper_title: Vision-as-Inverse-Graphics Agent via Interleaved Multimodal Reasoning

evidence.paraphrase: The write-run-render-compare loop retains rendered evidence across iterative inverse-graphics reasoning.
Plans, executable programs, diffs, and render history form an evolving context and skill library.
During operation, VIGA applies fixed-rule insertion or replacement to render and comparison history; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.
Execution feedback triggers fixed-loop revision of plans and code. For VIGA, this specifically supports LLM-mediated memory editing of render and comparison history.
During operation, VIGA applies explicit deletion or eviction of stored items to render and comparison history; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are explicitly linked for downstream retrieval, reasoning, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): During inference, the operative memory component (render and comparison history) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, LLM-mediated memory editing, explicit deletion or eviction of stored items; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
